headline: 🔥 THE TOP-OF-LIST AGENT IS NOW FOUR DAYS UNCALLED AND NOTHING HAS COME IN BEHIND HER — Amy G. filed Saturday night: interested YES, both price fields blank, “my buyers really like the property and have put it at the top of their list.” ⚠️ THE SHOWING FEED HAS NOW BEEN COMPLETELY SILENT FOR SIXTY-ONE HOURS across seven active listings with nothing booked ahead — no new tours, no new feedback, no cancellations. ⭐ That silence is exactly why she is the whole board today: she is the freshest buyer signal you own, and there is no second one coming to replace her.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 AMY G. OF ETHOS INTERNATIONAL FILED SATURDAY AT 11:24 PM off that afternoon's 1:00 PM tour: interested — YES, staged 3, and in her own words — "My buyers have just started looking. They really like the property and have put it at the top of their list." ⭐ SHE LEFT BOTH PRICE FIELDS BLANK, which makes this the FIFTH consecutive read since the 8/5 cut where nobody argued the number. ⭐ And she is the same agent who phoned from inside the house mid-showing — the channel is already open and warm. ⏰ THIS IS DAY FOUR AND A FULL BUSINESS DAY HAS NOW PASSED ON IT. Six ShowingTime sweeps since have returned nothing new on any listing, so this has not been overtaken by a better signal — there is no other signal. It is still the single best thing on the board and still the oldest unworked one.
hotSignals.action: CALL her. Two things in one conversation: answer the basement lights (the half of her phone question you never got back to — the garage half you already answered by text), and ask what she would change about the staging, since she scored it a 3 and is the only agent to score staging at all since the cut. Quote $295,000 only. ⛔ Call, don't email — co-op agents remain the no-email lane and the ruling that would change that is now eleven days open.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 AMBER G. OF KELLER WILLIAMS HOOVER: interested — YES, priced right — JUST RIGHT, staging 5 of 5, the highest score this listing has ever recorded. This was the FIRST read filed after the 8/5 price cut and it is the strongest pricing evidence the file carries. ⭐ Corroborated the same hour by a direct text to Gene asking whether the ceiling stains came from a previous leak — a question that is still unanswered a week later.
hotSignals.action: Answer the ceiling-stain question in writing — an unanswered condition question from an agent whose buyer said YES is the cheapest way to lose one. Then ask directly whether her buyer is still looking. ⚠️ This one has now aged past the seven-day outreach window, so the phone is the only lane left on it.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 WANDA W. OF MILLENNIUM HOMES answered the interest question with the single word "Very" and left every other field blank — off one of three tours filed within ninety minutes of each other on 8/8. ⚠️ THE ENTHUSIASM IS ON RECORD AND THE REASON IS NOT, which is exactly what makes it a phone call rather than an email. ⭐ Banked from the same three-form burst and still governing this listing: the objection is SIZE, not price — verified three ways, clearest being "Just too small."
hotSignals.action: Call her and find out what "Very" means — is her buyer still active, and what would need to be true. ⛔ Do not offer price: no discount reaches a size objection. Ten days of decay on the only enthusiastic read this listing has ever produced.

upcoming: 🆕 TODAY, TUE 8/18 — 225 WILLOW POINT: the BUY-side appointment nobody had ever worked. Gene asked Sondra yesterday at 3:17 PM whether this afternoon works to go see homes; this is the only live appointment shape on the board and it is not a ShowingTime event, so nothing here will confirm it for you.

⏰ THU 8/20, 3:00 PM — 5167 LAKE CREST CIR closing at the closing attorney's office. Not a ShowingTime event, but it is the nearest hard date on the board and the largest number closing this month. ⚠️ Two items landed today: the title company's preliminary policy at 10:09 AM, and the city inspector's sign-off scheduled ONTO closing day itself. Still no clear-to-close on any lane.

📭 NO SHOWINGS BOOKED, AND THE FEED HAS NOW BEEN SILENT FOR SIXTY-ONE HOURS. There is not one future showing, walk-through, inspection or appraisal confirmed on any listing, and nothing new has arrived since Saturday's 11:24 PM feedback. ⭐ Read it honestly: a quiet feed in mid-August across seven actives is a marketing problem, not a bad-luck week — and the only listing still producing signal is the one whose price moved.
✅ BEHIND YOU: the 225 Willow Point photo shoot and the Lay Lake listing walk-through, both held Monday; neither was a ShowingTime event and the Lay Lake one appeared on no calendar at all.

listings.note: ⭐ THE CAUSAL CHAIN IS THE CLEAREST ON YOUR BOARD AND IT IS SETTLED. Every read that ever said TOO HIGH was filed while the ask was $299,000. The cut went live 8/5. Since then: one JUST RIGHT with a five-of-five, one stairs complaint, one interested-No with blank price fields, and a YES with both price fields blank and a top-of-list comment. FIVE consecutive reads, not one of them arguing the number. A $4,000 experiment that worked — ⛔ do not reopen price with this seller. 🔴 THE LIVE ITEM IS THE BASEMENT LIGHTS, and it belongs to the hottest agent on the file. 🔴 Two agents with interested buyers — both of whom filed TOO HIGH at the old price — still do not know it moved. Both chips overdue since 8/8, now ten days. ⚠️ THE OUTREACH RULE COULD NOT FIRE AGAIN THIS MORNING: the standing send-autonomy rule puts co-op agents in the no-email lane, and the question that would unblock a one-off note has now been open eleven days. Four interested-YES agents are behind it. ⛔ Quote $295,000 only. ⛔ Call, don't email. 📊 Seventeen showings all-time, still the highest-traffic active in the book — and nothing new booked since Saturday.

listings.note: ✅ THE FEEDBACK GAP GOT AN ACTUAL FIX AND IT CAME FROM THE SELLER'S SIDE. Monday at 3:08 PM the institutional seller asked that showing feedback be routed to them directly through the showing platform, to take the back-and-forth off Gene's plate; he forwarded it at 3:09 and the operations manager confirmed it done at 3:27. ⭐ THAT IS THE RIGHT NEWS ON THIS PARTICULAR FILE — three showings deep with not one word returned is the single biggest information gap on the board, and the fix landed inside twenty minutes without Gene touching it. ⚠️ It does not retrieve the three reads already missed, and none has arrived since. ✅ THE PRICE IS INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED AND QUOTABLE at $550,000 — both Saturday notices print it. Every prior notice printed $559,000 because they all predated the cut. ⭐ THE TIMING IS THE POINT: the cut went live 8/13 and produced two tours inside forty-eight hours, six hours apart on the same Saturday, taking the all-time counter from 41 to 42 in a single day. That is the market answering the price question directly. 🔴 THE THREE-WEEK-OLD ITEM IS STILL THE ONE THAT WOULD MOVE THE NEEDLE: the 7/23 read said dirty plus GLITCHING ELECTRICAL, and the 8/4 read scored staging 2 of 5. The house did not get more expensive between those visits — it got less presentable. An electrician and a cleaner remain cheaper than another lost buyer. ⚠️ A live 8/10 social post still carries $559,000.

listings.note: 🔴 THE FINDING IS THE OBJECTION AND IT IS VERIFIED THREE WAYS: the problem is SIZE, not price. ⛔ NO DISCOUNT REACHES A SIZE OBJECTION — the answer is AUDIENCE, not a number: first-time buyers, downsizers, investors. This board argued for a cut here for weeks on the strength of silence; the showings arrived and said something different, and that earlier read is formally withdrawn. ✅ THE $5,000 CUT IS VERIFIED LIVE AND PUBLIC at $184,000 on three independent MLS lines, so the old do-not-quote hedge is retired. 🔴 The Saturday burst has fully decayed with the one phone call still unmade, and nothing new has booked in the nine days since. ⏰ The whole three-form burst drops out of the fourteen-day window in four days; the finding survives, the freshness does not.

listings.note: ✅ THE HAZARD THIS BOARD NAMED FOR THREE DAYS IS CLEARED. The inspection-response letter was never unsent — Gene sent it himself Saturday at 9:54 — and the document in the drafts folder was a DUPLICATE created six minutes later, now gone. ⭐ THE SHAPE OF THE BUYER'S ASK IS THE STORY: seventy-one items inspected, sixty-eight flagged at some level, and then exactly three requested. That is a reasonable buyer. ⭐ The recommendation sent is two yeses and a hold — agree to the basement leak and a scoped HVAC service, and on the roof ask for a few days and your own licensed roofer's report, because the inspector wrote that he cannot determine the roof's age or remaining life. ⚠️ FHA, so the appraiser can raise the roof independently and the concession room is small — this gets solved with work, not a check. 🔴 The date the buyers' repair-resolution window actually closes still does not exist anywhere in this system. ⭐ Closing 10/23. ⭐ Worth keeping from the read that just aged out: an agent wrote "didn't realize the laundry was in the basement" — that phrasing makes it a listing-copy fix, not a price fix, and it is a lesson that transfers to the next listing.

listings.note: ✅ THE CLEANEST FILE ON THE BOARD ON PAPER — inspection 8/5 at noon, appraisal 8/7 at 9:00 AM, both on primary ShowingTime notices, and the 8/28 close date cross-checked against three sources repeatedly and passed every time. ⭐ AN INSPECTION AND AN APPRAISAL BOTH SPENT IS THE STRONGEST POSITION ANY DEAL HERE OCCUPIES. ⚠️ An HVAC-concession discussion surfaced and the milestone watcher correctly declined it — it maps to a rung already spent, so nothing new has broken. 🔴 THE SELLER HAS BEEN WAITING ON A RETURNED CALL SINCE LAST TUESDAY — six days, mid-transaction, on the deal with the least to worry about. Client Monday existed for exactly this row and it did not get worked. ⚠️ The appraised value still has not come back — day twelve, a single-source observation rather than an alarm — and nobody has confirmed the closing attorney received the payoff. ⚠️ The buyer's agent asked for a specific co-op commission and nobody has ever answered.

The photo shoot happened Monday, both halves of it closed on Gene's word after this board spent a weekend calling it the loudest red row on the file. ✅ AND THE HALF NOBODY HAD EVER WORKED IS NOW OPEN — at 3:17 PM Monday Gene asked Sondra whether this afternoon works to go see the property she's interested in, and told them in the same message that the listing agreement had come through and offered to cover questions on it while they're together. ⭐ SHE CAME IN UNPROMPTED SAYING SHE WAS VERY INTERESTED IN A PROPERTY AND ABOUT READY TO LIST THEIR OWN. The LIST half has been in motion since Friday's seven executed documents; until Monday afternoon the BUY half had never been touched by anyone. 🔴 MLS INPUT PREP IS THE ONLY STEP LEFT between this house and the market this weekend. ⚠️ No buyer criteria or budget is recorded anywhere in the system, so today is the intake as well as the showing — and there is still no confirmation back on the appointment. ⚠️ The $185,000 price is Gene's own ruling — quotable, but with no primary MLS source behind it.

listings.note: 🛑 CONFIRMED EXPIRED YESTERDAY — the decision this board carried for four days was made by Gene at 1:13 PM Sunday and it was no. His note to the seller was unambiguous: the listing expires, the sign gets picked up, Don grabs the lockbox, everyone who had expressed interest has been told it is off the market, and all ads and media are stopped. ⭐ THE SHOWING RECORD SUPPORTS THE CALL, WHICH IS WHY IT BELONGS ON THIS BOARD RATHER THAN JUST IN THE FILE: two tours in the fourteen-day window and NOT ONE FORM RETURNED from either. Across the listing's whole life it produced exactly two feedback forms, and both left EVERY price field blank — 7/31 "Upstairs bathroom was a deal breaker because of the kids" and 7/12 "She LOVED the yard and lot" with the interior called too compartmentalized. ⭐ THAT IS THE UNUSUAL SHAPE WORTH REMEMBERING: 92 days, one written offer, and not a single agent who ever walked it argued the price. A house nobody objects to the price on, that nobody buys, has a positioning problem — and this seller was not going to change the layout. ⚠️ THE 8/11 'FULL-PRICE SHOWING' this board carried for two days never happened, by the showing agent's own admission, and the 8/13 second-showing request from the same agent contradicted his own text that morning and was never confirmed. 🔴 ONE PUBLIC-FACING LOOSE END IS STILL LIVE AND IT IS THE MACHINE'S FAULT, NOT GENE'S: a social carousel from 8/15 still presents this house as available at $450,000. Two minutes in the platform directly. ⚠️ The milestone engine also still carries this address in an active deal state. 📉 This row drops off the board entirely once its last showing ages out of the fourteen-day window on 8/28.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE — highest lead yield in the portfolio, and the septic answer is day 4 undelivered
listings.note: 🔥 NO SHOWINGS, BUT THE HIGHEST LEAD YIELD IN THE PORTFOLIO BY A WIDE MARGIN — nine names off this one ad, three of them in three days, while every other ad in the portfolio has produced zero. ✅ The 19-lot plat was located Friday and delivered — the exact document the open buyer chip had been waiting on. 🔴 THE HANDOFF IS THE PROBLEM, NOT THE COUNTY, AND IT IS DAY FOUR: the builder asked the septic perc question on 8/12, the operations manager researched and answered it completely, and that answer has sat on her board since Friday with nobody reading it back to him. The work was done; the delivery never happened. ⭐ THE PERC QUESTION IS PRICED, NOT BLOCKED: the county takes record searches in person only, weekdays 8:00–3:30, at a per-record fee — nineteen lots is a few hundred dollars and a half-day errand. So the choice is three-way: send someone for all nineteen, narrow to the lots a buyer is actually asking about, or ask the developer first, who almost certainly already holds the perc results from platting and charges nothing. ⭐ PERC DECIDES BUILDABILITY AND BUILDABILITY DECIDES PRICE PER LOT. ✅ A holding answer to the buyer is drafted and staged — send it, don't rewrite it.

listings.status: 🔴 ACTIVE — eighteen days quiet, and the good news is still undelivered
listings.note: 🔴 TWO TOURS IN FIVE DAYS AT THE END OF JULY, THEN NOTHING. On a listing that had gone 126 days with essentially no traffic, that burst was the only real activity this file ever produced and it has fully decayed. ⭐ THE GOOD NEWS IS STILL UNDELIVERED AT EIGHTEEN DAYS, THE OLDEST OWED ITEM ON THE BOARD: the 7/31 read came back interested No, but priced JUST RIGHT, 4 of 5, with the comment that the buyers prefer the east end of the beach although they liked this complex. That is a GEOGRAPHY loss, not a price loss, and the only independent validation of this list price the file has ever carried. ⚠️ IT HAS SLID OUT OF THE FOURTEEN-DAY WINDOW and no longer appears in the rolling feedback count above — the finding stands, the clock on delivering it has run out. ⭐ He is out of state and lives on these reads. Lead with the price answer, not the no.

listings.status: ⚠️ ACTIVE — biggest listing in the book, zero activity, seller identity unverified
listings.note: ⚠️ THE LARGEST NUMBER ON THE BOARD IS STILL THE ONE WITH THE WEAKEST FILE — no showing, no feedback, no correspondence in the fourteen-day window, and today added nothing. ⛔ THE CLIENT IDENTITY REMAINS UNVERIFIED under the identity law; a name carried in memory is not a receipt, and on a $1.15M listing that gates every piece of client-facing creative. ⭐ THE POSITIONING READ IS THE MOST USEFUL THING ON THE FILE: the only tour it ever took said the buyer liked the house but the land wasn't what he was looking for. The objection is ACREAGE — the cheapest possible loss at this price point, because nobody has ever said it is too expensive. ⭐ So the open question is a TARGETING one: who is the buyer who wants THIS land, and is the marketing pointed at them. ⚠️ Four stale hands-up on this address's social posts are the only inbound interest in two weeks, and still unworked.

listings.status: 🔴 ACTIVE — no showing activity; the owed item here is a phone call
listings.note: 🔴 THE LONGEST-RUNNING BROKEN PROMISE ON THE BOARD, AND ANOTHER DAY PASSED WITHOUT IT MOVING — twenty-five days. She waited nineteen days without complaining, then escalated three times in twenty-seven minutes on a Wednesday night. ✅ The emergency half resolved without Gene: power is back on and the tenant paid his balance, both confirmed. ⭐ WHAT SHE ACTUALLY ASKED IS STILL UNANSWERED — is the tenant out, because he owes another month if he isn't. ⚠️ The answer is not required to make the call, and waiting for one is exactly what turned six days into twenty-five.

oweFeedback.when: 🔴 THREE ASKS AND TWENTY-EIGHT DAYS OF SILENCE — 7/21, 7/22 and 7/23, from the RealtySouth Inverness listing side after the 7/21 1:00 PM tour. ⭐ THIS IS THE ONE THAT COSTS SOMETHING REAL, and the cost is not the courtesy — it is that the honest written answer IS the counter on the largest number on the board, roughly $36K of GCI. The listing side has asked repeatedly to be moved forward; a seller who reverse-offers a buyer is a seller who wants a deal. Twenty minutes of writing moves it. ⚠️ The appraisal figure the buyer cited as far under ask is single-sourced from him — do not quote it to the other side as an appraised value.

⏰ TWO FEEDBACK REQUESTS, 7/31 and 8/1, from the Keller Williams Hoover listing side. The listing went from CONTINGENT to EXPIRED between the two notices, so the ask is stale — but a one-line courtesy reply costs nothing and this is a Lake Crest-subdivision agent you will meet again this week at a closing table.
